ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point D is on segment $CB$. If $AB=10$ and $DB=2$, then what is the length of segment $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $AB$ and $AB=10$, \\ 
it follows that $BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$, \\
Furthermore, since $DB=2$, \\
it follows that $CD=BC-DB=\boxed{3}$.
